title: Global crash recovery and reverse engineering programs outside the US

tellings.quote: And there are there are global crash recovery and reverse engineering programs um outside the US.

plain: There are programmes in other countries, outside the United States, that recover crashed unknown craft and try to work out how they function. Jake Barber, a former helicopter pilot who says he flew a UFO retrieval mission himself, passes this on second-hand. It would mean the United States is not the only country holding such craft.
